# mspm0-skill documentation

Canonical repository: https://github.com/Ibook000/mspm0-skill
This site presents the repository's MSPM0 Agent skill rules, board references, example snapshots and verification semantics. The repository source is authoritative if there is a discrepancy.

- MSPM0 AI Agent 开发文档: https://ibook000.github.io/mspm0-skill/index.html
- 安装与快速开始: https://ibook000.github.io/mspm0-skill/start.html
- 芯片与板卡规则: https://ibook000.github.io/mspm0-skill/boards.html
- MSPM0 示例索引: https://ibook000.github.io/mspm0-skill/examples.html
- SysConfig 与 DriverLib 工作流: https://ibook000.github.io/mspm0-skill/workflow.html
- 检查与调试工具: https://ibook000.github.io/mspm0-skill/tools.html
- MSPM0 常见问题: https://ibook000.github.io/mspm0-skill/faq.html
- 验证状态与证据边界: https://ibook000.github.io/mspm0-skill/verification.html

- Agent rules: https://github.com/Ibook000/mspm0-skill/blob/main/SKILL.md
